The problem

Cognitive load doesn't clock out.

Deep work, exam prep, back-to-back client calls, late nights on a deadline — sustained mental effort taxes the nervous system the same way physical effort taxes a muscle. Most tools people reach for — caffeine, more willpower, another app — don't address the underlying state of the nervous system itself. Serene works at that level.

How it works

The science, kept simple.

Serene uses gentle, non-invasive electrical stimulation delivered through the outer ear — a technique known as transcutaneous auricular vagus nerve stimulation (taVNS). The vagus nerve is a key regulator of the body's autonomic nervous system, influencing stress response, alertness, and recovery. By stimulating a specific point on the outer ear with a mild, precisely calibrated signal, Serene helps shift the nervous system toward a calmer, more focused state — without drugs, without caffeine, and without anything invasive.

Stimulation site
Outer ear

Mild biphasic

Credibility

Built at the intersection of hardware, software, and clinical science.

Serene is developed by a multidisciplinary founding team spanning software, electronics, and biomedical science, incubated at SRM's Directorate of Entrepreneurship and Innovation. The team includes a physician co-founder overseeing the biomedical and clinical validation work.

FAQ

Good to know.

Is this a medical device?+
No. Serene is positioned as a wellness device for everyday cognitive performance, not a diagnostic or therapeutic medical device.
Is it safe?+
Serene uses mild, non-invasive stimulation at levels designed for everyday wellness use. Full safety validation is part of our ongoing development process ahead of launch.
How long do I wear it for?+
Sessions are short — a few minutes at a time, as needed throughout your day.
